title: Scan Diagnosis
subtitle: Real-time diagnosis of scan chain failures using topology analysis, AI root cause detection and engineering recommendations.

ml_status.client_summary: AI analyzed 5,089 test failures. Root cause estimated for 5,089 records. 5.0% flagged as unusual for engineer review. Scan-cell confidence uses a model trained on past physical confirmations.

confidence.confidence_definition: Per-cell: 0.50*evidence + 0.50*calibrated_GBM_PFA_prob (or 0.55/0.45 logistic fallback); evidence = 0.40*relative_dominance + 0.25*pattern_corroboration + 0.20*obs_share + 0.15*fail_type_consistency. ML: isotonic-calibrated Gradient Boosting on historical PFA confirmations. Dashboard KPI: fail-weighted mean of per-chain top-1 confidence.
